description: One derived JSON document of (component, CVE) matches, in the layout of CaptureKind security.osv-matches: queried (the components OSV answered in full), not_checked (each with why), affected (purl, cve_id, osv_id, and the versions OSV lists as fixed), count, and unkeyed (advisories with no CVE alias).
